decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.
Condition : 3 - The existing bricks should be carefully dismantled and stored on site for re-use within the development.

Condition : 4 - Sample panels of brickwork, showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the works are commenced and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work is completed and has been approved.

Condition : 5 - The wall is to be rebuilt with existing recovered bricks to an agreed bond, joint finish and mortar mix.  Detailing of the triming of the opening and of the wall capping area also to be supplied to the satisfaction of the LPA prior to works commencing on site.
description: Demolition and rebuilding of wall to rear of 59/60 High Street. (Listed Building)
